title: epicampes stricta var. distichophylla
intro: Epicampes stricta var. distichophylla, commonly known as the "Fijian pepper tree" or "Mountain pepper tree", is a plant species native to the Pacific island of Fiji. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The plant is known for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and providing antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Epicampes stricta var. distichophylla include piperine, which is responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
